source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the divisions of the PNS (PDF 42-43).

blocks.text: PNS do qisam ke raaste (pathways ya divisions) banata hai: sensory pathways aur motor pathways. Sensory pathways mein spinal aur cranial nerves ke sensory neurons hain jo jism ke receptors ko CNS se jorte hain. Motor pathways mein spinal aur cranial nerves ke motor neurons hain jo CNS ko jism ke effectors se jorte hain. Motor pathways do systems banate hain: somatic nervous system aur autonomic nervous system.

Yeh spinal aur cranial nerves ke un motor neurons par mushtamil hai jo skeletal muscles ko qaboo karte hain. Somatic system iradi (voluntary) hai, yaani skeletal muscles ko apni marzi se hilaya ja sakta hai. Reflex action mein somatic system shaoori (conscious) qaboo ke baghair kaam karta hai.

Yeh spinal aur cranial nerves ke un motor neurons par mushtamil hai jo smooth muscles aur glands ko qaboo karte hain. Autonomic system be-iradah (involuntary) hai aur smooth muscles ko qaboo kar ke jism ki andaruni halaton ko sambhalta hai. Maslan yeh saans, dil ki dharkan, hazme aur doosre kaamon ko qaboo karta hai. Autonomic system ke do hisse hain: sympathetic division aur parasympathetic division.

Yeh jismani ya jazbati dabao (stress) mein jism ko tayyar karta hai. Sympathetic nervous system ke motor neurons spinal cord ke thoracic aur lumbar hisson se shuru hote hain. In neurons ke axons mukhtalif andaruni aaza (visceral organs, yaani smooth muscles aur glands) tak pohanchte hain. Jab sympathetic nervous system active hota hai to us ke motor neurons mukhtalif smooth muscles aur glands ko jaga kar jism ko "lado ya bhago" (fight or flight) ke liye tayyar karte hain. Maslan dil tez aur zor se dharakta hai, khoon mein glucose ki miqdar barhti hai, khoon ka bahao muscles aur dil ki taraf mor diya jata hai, aur bronchioles phail jati hain.

Khatra ya dabao guzar jane ke baad yeh system sympathetic nervous system ke asar ka ulat (antagonise) karta hai. Parasympathetic nervous system ke motor neurons dimagh aur spinal cord ke sacral hisse se shuru hote hain. In mein se bohat se motor neurons vagus (daswin cranial) nerve mein hain. Yeh motor neurons andaruni aaza tak pohanch kar unhein naarmal halat mein wapas le aate hain. Maslan dil ki dharkan aahista hoti hai, dil aur skeletal muscles ko khoon ka bahao kam hota hai, hazme ke aaza ka ifraz aur doosre kaam barh jate hain, waghaira.

blocks.title: Table ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sympathetic ko "khatre ka system" samjhein: putli phailti, dil tez, saans ki nalyan (bronchioles) khulti, khoon muscles ki taraf aur jigar se glucose. Is waqt hazma zaroori nahin, is liye laab, mede ka ifraz aur aanton ki harkat kam. Parasympathetic "aaram aur hazme ka system" hai aur taqreeban har cheez ulat karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Imtihan se pehle dil tez dharakta hai aur munh khushk hai. Kaun sa hissa active hai, aur munh khushk kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Sympathetic nervous system: yeh dil ki raftar barhata hai aur laab ke glands ka ifraz kam karta hai.

items: Somatic: iradi, skeletal muscles (reflex mein be-shaoor). Autonomic: be-iradah, smooth muscles aur glands.
Sympathetic (thoracic aur lumbar): lado ya bhago. Parasympathetic (dimagh aur sacral, khaas kar vagus nerve): jism wapas naarmal.
